content: {"a_point": "When a measure provisionnelle orders the expulsion of a concierge from their service apartment after the employment contract has been validly terminated, the court must verify that the conditions of Art. 261 CPC are met, including a serious risk of irreparable harm to the landlord/employer and a proper balancing of interests, while applying a heightened standard of proof due to the definitive nature of the measure.", "b_propositions": [{"a_id": "S29", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "rule"}, {"a_id": "S52", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "condition"}, {"a_id": "S71", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "answer"}]}
